comment: S21 Parts 3-4: the quest & rumor text pack v1 (docs/quest-text-pack-v1.md), planner-authored — wired as data, never rewritten here. Placeholders: {town} {region} {target} {card} {reward} {steps} {want}.

courier: A parcel for {town}, wrapped in oilcloth and questions. Don't open it. {reward} on delivery.
My sister in {town} needs this before the roads worsen. They always worsen.
This letter outlived two couriers already. Third time pays for all — {reward}, when it reaches {town}.
Take the ledger to {town}. Walk quickly and read nothing.
cardCourier: A collector in {town} wants {want} — wants it gone from here, more like. It travels the moment we shake on it.
The {want} in your keeping would settle an old debt in {town}. Old debts pay new gold.
There's a buyer in {town} for {want}. Ask no questions and carry none with it.
bounty: {target} has been seen on the {region} roads. The purse stands at {reward}, and it stands lonely.
Whatever walks the {region} wearing that shape — the reeve wants it stopped. {reward}, no questions on the manner.
Third caravan this season. The {region} pays {reward} to whoever ends it.
retrieval: It's in the lair in the {region} — past the resident, which is the whole trouble. Bring it back or keep it; we'll pay either way you choose wrong.
My grandmother's {card} went into that den with my grandmother. The {card}, at least, can come back.
The thing you want sits behind the thing you don't. {reward} if it reaches me.

chainLinks: Ask at {town} — the ferryman there saw where it went.
The shepherds in the {region} tell it differently. Go hear them tell it.
Old {town} charcoal-burners know that country. Buy a round and buy the truth.

guardians.reya: In the Last Chapel they bury no one twice. She won't allow it.
guardians.arcanis: The hermit of the Reach reads three futures in a breath. Bring him a fourth.
guardians.drana: The Barrowlands' mistress tithes in blood, and pays her debts in it too.
guardians.drakuseth: Brand's folk saw wings over the caldera at dusk. Three farms burned in a single pass.
guardians.titania: Fell a tree in the Deepwood, then count your breaths until the ground answers.

lords.unwinder: The tide at the Spire runs backward, and what it takes comes back wrong.
lords.usher: The duchess of the old court receives all the dead, and returns none.
lords.warden: The walls of the Bastion are alive, and the tallest of them holds the keys.
lords.stoker: Every spell spoken near the Furnace Gate, something inside hears it. And grows hungrier.
lords.sower: Plant nothing within sight of the Throne. It will grow, and it will not be yours.

rumors.moxPointer: There's a door in the {region} that opens for no key. Something older than keys waits behind it.
rumors.moxPointerDeep: Five doors, five sleepless things, five prizes that were old when the strongholds were quarried.
rumors.vaultTease: Five seats of power, five treasures taken. And beneath them all, they say — a flower.
rumors.nighthawkLegend: They found the last one drained white on the fen road, purse untouched. Walk wide of the Nighthawk — or walk in numbers, and count the payout worth it.
warp: The old currents run crosswise in this country. Some call it opportunity. Widows call it otherwise.
Five powers ride the crossed currents, and the riding frays the plane. Ask why the birds fly widdershins near the spokes' ends.
texture: The roads are the reeve's as far as the lanterns reach. Past that, they're whoever's walking them.
Whitewell's bell rings itself some mornings. Nobody mends it. Nobody dares.
The wild towns trade in things the civilized ones pretend not to want.
Steps are cheap, they say. They say it young.
rumors.manalinkPointer: The wardens of {town} are hiring, and the pay isn't coin. It's the kind of gift that walks with you after.
